title: Design, CTAB-catalyzed ultrasound-assisted synthesis and tyrosinase inhibition potential of naphthofuran-triazole conjugates
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37521-37538

A novel series of naphthofuran-triazole conjugates has been synthesized to assess their potential against bacterial tyrosinase enzyme via in vitro and in silico studies.
